baseline.method: PALA radial-symmetry localization, native complex128 oracle, full 30 real acquisition blocks; reference agreement only

reference_kind: validated standard method, not actual anatomical ground truth
nrmse_definition: sqrt(mean((estimate-reference)^2))/(max(reference)-min(reference)), full declared array, no fitted alignment or rescaling
threshold_provenance: Frozen before local implementation; single-precision original failed these gates and was retained as a precision comparison. Complex128 computation is independently verified without changing these boundaries.

output_units.reconstruction: distinct retained trajectory crossings per superpixel
